snippet.title: Jackal - Launch Date Reveal - Trailer
snippet.description:
THURSDAY FEBRUARY 5th https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124230/Jackal/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=launchdate

A blood-soaked fusion of Hotline Miami and Pulp Fiction, delivering brutal executions and relentless close-combat.

Prepare for an adrenaline-charged thrill ride with Jackal, the highly anticipated top-down shooter from the legendary indie game developer Michał Marcinkowski, creator of Soldat, King Arthur’s Gold, and Maniac. Coming February 5th 2026 on Steam, Jackal merges the relentless brutality of Hotline Miami with a Hunter Thompson/Tarantino-esque narrative set against the gritty backdrop of 1970s Las Vegas.

"Jackal combines my love of John Wick fight scenes, Scorsese's mobsters, Tarantino's storytelling, and the soul of the 1970s," says the creator Michał Marcinkowski.

Add the game to your wishlist now, on the Steam Page and buy it on launch! 


Contact: pr@thd.vg
